title: Etale-local uniqueness of lifts through a thickening

difficulty_reason: Builds the etale covering with 2-morphism data: constructs I' = W' x_{x',X',x''} W'' with the universal 2-morphism gamma, reduces to extending the section delta : W -> I' after an etale covering, handles the first-order case by the infinitesimal lifting criterion, delegates the general case to the smooth-strong-lift engine, and verifies f''_k etale via the deform-property lemma.
